item.content:encoded:
It is rare indeed for me to upvote a -J. Not because I'm against the concept, but simply because I'm kinda hard judging jokes.

The balance between clinical and emotional writing, the crescendo of things never letting you down, laying ground for the next paragraph without dragging things, the foul language used sparingly to add emphasis without getting annoying. The end result in which it is extremely easy to relate to, but it is still, in the end, a true anomaly in its intensity. Absurd enough, not too much absurd.

Upvoted. The balance needed to craft a good joke was achieved with excellence.
